Every hour, Paige can bake 3 banana bread loaves in the oven.  Each banana bread loaf is cut into 6 slices and wrapped individually for sale.  Each slice is sold for 60 cents for a fundraiser.  If she baked from 2:00 PM - 7:00 PM straight, and sold all the slices, how much did she raise in dollars?

An 9-year old child wants to buy a toy car which costs $15. He already has $3 savings. How many days will it take him to save the remaining amount of money if he promises to save $3 daily from his allowance?

Hannah's city is having a big display of fireworks for the 4th of July. They're going to set off 20 boxes of 25 fireworks each. Hannah's house is at the right angle to see 50% of the town's fireworks. Hannah will also set off 4 boxes of 6 fireworks each in her backyard. How many fireworks will Hannah see in total?

Marie ordered one chicken meal that costs $15, 5 packs of milk that costs $5 each, 6 apples that cost $1.50 each, and some boxes of pizza. Marie paid a total of $83. How many boxes of pizza did Marie order if each box costs $8.50?
Charlie has boots that are four times the size of Sophie's. If Sophie wears size six boots, what is the average size of shoe worn by the two?

Julia’s boat sprang a leak while she was out on the lake. The boat was taking on three liters of water for every fifteen feet she rowed back towards shore. It took her twenty seconds to row thirty feet. The shore was 80 seconds away. How much water had the boat taken on by the time Julia reached shore?
Jen decides to travel to 5 different countries. He has to pay $500 for the supplies he needs, in total. The tickets for travel cost, in total, 60% more than the supplies. How much does travel cost?
Jill and her friends watch 6 movies every Saturday and half the number of movies on Sunday than on Saturday. If they watch movies every weekend, how many movies can they watch in 3 weeks?

Ali has three $50 bills and five $10 bills that he saved after working for Mr. James on his farm. Ali gives his sister half of the total money he has and uses 2/3 of the remaining amount of money to buy dinner. Calculate the amount of money he has after buying the dinner.

Bryce and four of his friends each ordered their own pizzas after football practice. Each pizza had 16 slices. Bryce and two friends ate 3/4 of their pizzas. The two remaining friends ate 1/2 of their pizzas. How many slices of pizza were left?
Eight of the kids in Gina's class are allergic to dairy, 6 are allergic to peanuts and 2 are allergic to both. If there are 35 kids in her class, how many aren't allergic to anything?

John hires a driving service to get him to work each day.  His work is 40 miles away and he has to go there and back each day. He goes to work 5 days a week for 48 weeks a year. The service charges him $3 per mile driven and he also gives his driver a $200 bonus per month. How much does he pay a year for driving?
Carl buys fifteen packs of cookies. Each pack of cookies has eight cookies inside. Each cookie cost $0.20. How much change does Carl receive if he pays with a $20 bill?
It costs $250 per meter to repave a street. Monica's street is 200 meters long. How much more does it cost to repave Lewis' street, which is 600 meters long?
Darrell and Allen's ages are in the ratio of 7:11. If their total age now is 144, calculate Allen's age 12 years from now.
Gretchen has some coins. There are 50 more gold coins than silver coins. If she had 90 gold coins, how many coins did Gretchen have in total?

Three teenagers are playing soccer on the weekend. Richie, the first teenager, scored 30 more goals than Mark and scored 55 more goals than Anna. If Richie scored 90 goals, how many goals did all three teenagers score?
Susan earns $8 every 12 minutes for an online task she does. If she works between 8 a.m. and 12 a.m. and pauses in between for half an hour, how much money does she earn for the online task?

Sally has realized she did not receive a full wage this week. Her bank account, which held $500 at the start of the week, now holds $720. She has received no other money into her bank account this week. If her weekly wage should be $500, how many dollars were withheld from Sally’s wage?

Ali is a superstar counter. He has won 30 medals for counting super fast. His friend Izzy is also a really good counter and has 7 less medals than Ali. Together they have 15 times less medals than have been given out for counting. How many medals have been given out for counting?

A wooden bridge can carry no more than 5000 pounds. A delivery truck filled with identical boxes, each weighing 15 pounds, will pass over the bridge. The combined weight of the driver and the empty truck is 3800 pounds. What is the maximum number of boxes which can be loaded onto the truck while not exceeding the bridge's weight limit?
A pet store currently has 7 dogs, 3 cats, and 15 birds. How many legs in total do the pets in the store have?

Leila buys 4 cucumbers from the market, with each cucumber costing $3. Jack buys 6 tomatoes from the grocery store, with each tomato priced at $2. Chase buys 2 heads of lettuce from the farmer’s market, where each lettuce costs $4. Together, how much did the three of them spend to make a salad for the potluck?
John buys a cassette with 2 songs. The first song is 7 minutes and the second song is 80% longer. How much time is the total CD?

Rose went to the store on Monday and bought 2 cakes. Tuesday she went to a different store and bought four times that number of cakes. On Wednesday she went to another store and bought 6 times the number of cakes she did on Tuesday. How many cakes did she buy after all three days?

Gene is sewing a quilt out of old souvenir t-shirts. He has one shirt from each vacation he has been on. Every shirt is its own quilt block. Each row is made of blocks from a different year of vacations. He goes on three vacations a year and has been vacationing since he was 25 years old. He is now 36. How many quilt blocks does he have in total?
Mark buys one lottery ticket with a 30% chance of winning and a second lottery ticket that's twice as likely to win. What is the probability, expressed as a percentage, that both tickets are winners?
Jean has 50 lollipops. Jean eats 5 of the lollipops. With the remaining lollipops, Jean wants to package 3 lollipops in one bag. How many bags can Jean fill?

Kelly is grocery shopping at a supermarket and is making sure she has enough in her budget for the items in her cart. Her 7 packs of bacon cost $14 in total and she has 8 packets of chicken which each cost twice as much as a pack of bacon. She also has 4 packs of strawberries, priced at $5 each, and 8 packs of apples, each priced at half the price of a pack of strawberries. If Kelly’s budget is $95 then how much money, in dollars, does she have left in her budget?

Paul is driving a car twice a day: in the morning, and in the afternoon. He did that for 20 days. Each morning ride cost him about $8, and each afternoon ride, about $3. How much money did he spend on driving his car during these three weeks?

Amalia, Megan, and Dior divided the home chores so that each person had something to do while the others were working. Amalia's work was to mow the lawn, which took her 6 hours. Megan had to walk the dog and this took her 3 hours longer than Amalia to complete her chore. Dior's work was to do laundry and she took well over 5 hours longer than the time Amalia took to mow the lawn. Calculate the total time they all took to do their chores altogether.

To be promoted to the next school year, Jane takes 3 tests that together must total at least 45 points. On her first test, Jane scored 18 points, on the second test she scored 20 points. What is the minimum number of points she must score on the third test to pass?

Jamal's phone can hold 8 times more photographs than can Brittany's phone. The maximum number of photographs that Brittany's phone can hold is 40 times more than the number of birds in Jamal's photograph of the ducks at the park. If Jamal's phone can hold 2400 photographs, how many ducks can be seen in Jamal's photograph of ducks at the park?
Tracy used a piece of wire 5 feet long to support tomato plants in the garden. The wire was cut into pieces 6 inches long. How many pieces did she obtain?

Steve assembled a puzzle that took 15 hours of intense effort to complete. Anna assembled the same puzzle in 3 hours more than half Steve's time. How long did it take Anna to finish the difficult puzzle?

Bill is signing up for a new streaming service. He got a special introductory deal where the first 6 months were $6 a month, then it went up to the normal price of $15 a month. After 8 months of the normal rate, the service increased its price to $18 a month. How much do 2 years of the service cost him?
A restaurant has 20 tables with 4 legs and 30 tables with 3 legs. Calculate the total number of legs the restaurant's tables have.

Sandra, the florist around the corner, is very unhappy with Fred's incomplete order delivery. Sandra had ordered three times as many red roses as white carnations. She also ordered 150 pink calla lilies, which were five times the number of white carnations. Sandra has threatened to switch suppliers if the missing red roses are not delivered by 5 pm. To keep Sandra's business, how many red roses must Fred deliver by 5 pm?
Every 3 miles a car drives the tires rotate 870 times.  Jeremy drives 600 miles a month.  If each tire can undergo 16,704,000 rotations how many years before the tire needs to be replaced?

Juan asked his neighbor, Herb, how much his house was worth. Herb answered that he paid $66,000 for the house. If Juan's house is 20% less expensive than Herb's, calculate the value of the two houses combined.

It takes 30 minutes for the oil to heat up to 350 degrees. It then takes 50% longer for the oil to heat up to the desired temperature of 450 degrees. After warming the oil, it takes 7 minutes less time to cook than it took to warm up the oil. How much time passes from starting the oil to having cooked chicken?

Robert had 6 pounds of candy, Cindy had 7 pounds of candy, and Aaron had 5 pounds of candy after Halloween. If they decide to pool and share their candy equally with each other, how much candy would each of them have?
After scoring 16 points, Erin now has three times more points than Sara, who scored 6. How many points did Erin have before?

Carrie is planning the caroling schedule. The choir plans to sing "Deck the Halls" three times and "Jingle Bells" twice. If "Deck the Halls" is 180 seconds long and "Jingle Bells" is 200 seconds long, how long will they be caroling?
Marty has 200 centimeters of ribbon that he must cut into 5 equal parts. Each of the cut parts must be divided into 4 equal parts. How long will each final cut be?

The book is printed on paper that, when stacked, is 150 pages to the inch. Each paper is printed on both sides, with one page of the book printed on each side. How many pages are in the book, if it is 1.8 inches thick?

Teresa sells large stuffed animals for four times the price of small stuffed animals. Today, she sold three times as many small stuffed animals as large ones and earned $240 from the sales. Each small stuffed animal costs $6. How many small stuffed animals did she sell?
Last night Rick killed 12 wolves and 18 cougars while hunting. Today Rick killed three times as many wolves as cougars and three fewer cougars than the previous night. How many animals did Rick kill?

Felix notices that kids in the neighborhood are always getting things stuck in trees. Since he is an expert tree climber, he decides to start charging kids to retrieve their belongings. He sets his fee based on the height he has to climb. Each branch he has to ascend costs $.50. Over the week, he earned $210. On average, how many branches did he climb per day?

Rozanne is making eggnog for her family. She uses 6 dozen eggs that were in cases and another 3 eggs that were loose in the cupboard. She puts out  trays that each hold 4 glasses of eggnog. If each glass requires 6 eggs, how many trays can Rozanne arrange?

Lauren is saving 15% of every paycheck. How many more years does Lauren need to work if she plans to save for a retirement period of 25 years, live with 35% of her current annual salary, and her current salary is $120,000?

Bill is trying to figure out how many water bottles he needs to buy for his party. He started has 3 cases of water, each containing 30 bottles. He is expecting 80 guests and wants to provide 3 bottles of water for each attendee. How many additional bottles of water will he need to buy?
James delivers 800 newspapers in a day. He delivers 298 newspapers to District A, some to District B and 309 newspapers to District C. How many newspapers does he deliver to District B?

John and DeSean bought a bag of marshmallows to make s'mores together. The bag has 40 marshmallows. Each S'more uses one marshmallow. If John makes 8 S'mores, DeSean makes 8 S'mores, and they dropped 4 marshmallows on the ground, how many S'mores can each kid have with the marshmallows left in the bag?
How many girls are in the school if 30% of a school population is made up of 180 boys?
